title: Demon Slayer
start: Talk to Gideon Bede at the Saradominist church north of Varrock Museum in north-east Varrock.

rewards.t: 3 x 100 Combat XP lamps in one of the following skills: scl | Attack , scl | Strength , scl | Defence , scl | Constitution , scl | Ranged , scl | Magic or scl | Necromancy
The Silverlight sword, especially strong against demon-type monsters.
If you lose it, you can get a new one from Gideon Bede.
Talk to Historian Minas at the Varrock Museum to receive 5 kudos (members only).

steps.t: Talk to Gideon Bede inside the church in north-east Varrock. [Chat: Accept]
Climb down the trapdoor in the room.
Walk north and speak to any of the spirits. [Chat: 1 I come seeking Silverlight.]

Speak to the Spirit of the Mind inside the eastern room. [Chat: 1 Yes. › 1 I seek the Silverlight. › 3 A sword that slays demons. › 2 A powerful demon threatens Varrock. › 1 Delrith. › 3 Gideon Bede.]
Speak to the Spirit of Faith in the northern room, who'll guide you to the other side. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Speak to the Spirit of the Body in the western room. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to the spirits in the central room.
Take Silverlight from the altar. Make sure you actually take the Silverlight in the rock in the centre of the room or you will not be able to do the next steps.
Read the scroll to the north of the trapdoor.
Head south to Aubury's Rune Shop. South of the shop is a trapdoor just outside the Zamorak temple. Climb down the trapdoor.
Make your way west to the large room, killing all the cultists along the way.
Fight Delrith. Run into Gideon's dome shield to negate most of the damage. Only Silverlight or Darklight will work.
